headline: Invesco (IVZ) Stock May Trade At A Premium On Fee Pressure Risk
summary: Invesco stock has more than doubled over the past three years, yet on broad valuation checks it no longer looks obviously cheap. Investors are weighing a strong share price run against signals that the stock may now be closer to fairly priced than a clear bargain. Invesco has delivered a 100.4% total return over the past three years, which puts extra focus on whether recent gains already reflect much of the good news.
